name: Verna Furlbrow
summary: Verna Furlbrow waits beside her broken wagon near Westfall’s northern border. Bandits drove her from her family’s pumpkin patch, and the road to Elwynn Forest has left her stranded.

sections.title: A String of Misfortunes
sections.body: Verna and her husband farmed pumpkins in northern Westfall until lawlessness drove them from their land. After outlaws took the farm, they loaded what they could onto their cart and set out for Elwynn Forest with their horse, Old Blanchy. Their wagon broke down just down the road from the abandoned Jansen Stead. Unable to repair the axle or continue, Verna now faces the elements, bandit raids, and scavengers. She depends on travelers to keep her household fed and guarded.

sections.title: Heart of the Hearth
sections.body: Verna still welcomes those who have been driven to the roadside. Known for creating Westfall Stew, she shares meals and warm fires with wandering transients and refugees who have suffered similar fates. To fill her cooking pot, she needs ingredients gathered from the fields, including boar snouts, murloc eyes, okra, and stringy vulture meat. She makes hearty meals for the destitute from what the harsh frontier provides.

faq.q: Why is Verna Furlbrow camped along the road?
faq.answer: Verna and her husband fled their pumpkin farm after outlaws overran northern Westfall. Their wagon broke down near the Jansen Stead as they traveled toward Elwynn Forest, leaving them stranded beside the road.

faq.q: Who is Farmer Furlbrow to her?
faq.answer: Farmer Theodore Furlbrow is Verna's husband. They worked their Westfall homestead together until bandits drove them from their land.
Westfall Stew is a frontier dish Verna created. She makes it with wild boar snouts, stringy vulture meat, murloc eyes, and okra gathered from neighboring abandoned farms to feed stranded refugees.

faq.q: What happened to the Furlbrows' farm?
faq.answer: The Furlbrows' pumpkin farm in northern Westfall was taken by organized bandits during the kingdom's recent security breakdown. They had to leave their home and fields.

angles.text: Verna created Westfall Stew and teaches frontier cooks to turn scavenged meats and wild crops into a hearty meal.
The stranded Furlbrows show the human cost of Stormwind's neglected borders, where ordinary people are driven from their homes without royal soldiers sent to defend them.
